notes: The network PIN is gone: with phone / tablet access on, a device on your private network opens TechLog with no password.
A banner in the window tells you when a newer TechLog is out, even with no aircraft loaded; Update now installs it when the sim is closed.
Virtual airlines: an Owner can let pilots use a free plane of the same type when the registration does not match (Fly this plane).
A340-300 and A350: flap overspeed at CONF 1 is judged against the slats-only limit, since the aircraft pulls the flaps in by itself.
